item.title: chen08209/FlClash
item.description:
A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta,simple and easy to use, open-source and ad-free.

https://chen08209.github.io/FlClash

FlClash

A multi-platform proxy client based on ClashMeta. Simple to use, open source and ad-free.

English · 简体中文

Website · Download · Changelog · Build from source

Features

  • One app for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux, with x64 and ARM64 builds on the desktop.
  • mihomo (Clash.Meta) core with rule routing, proxy groups, latency tests, system proxy and TUN mode.
  • Profiles from a subscription link or a file, with a built-in editor, override scripts, and custom rules, proxies and proxy groups.
  • Live views of connections, requests, DNS queries and logs.
  • Material You design with Apple-style interaction: dynamic color, light and dark themes, continuous corners, sheets that snap between heights, and layouts that adapt from phones to desktops.
  • Backup and restore through WebDAV or a local file.
  • Platform touches: a Quick Settings tile, per-app proxy and Android TV support on Android; a tray menu and global hotkeys on the desktop.
  • Open source and ad-free, licensed under GPL-3.0.

Download

Get the latest build from GitHub Releases, or open the website, which picks the right file for your device.

Platform Packages Notes
Android APK for arm64 (arm64-v8a), armv7 (armeabi-v7a) and amd64 (x86_64) Most phones use arm64. Also on the F-Droid repository below.
Windows 10 and later Installer (.exe) or portable .zip, for x64 and ARM64 Pick ARM64 on Snapdragon and other ARM laptops.
macOS 12 and later DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel Also on Homebrew.
Linux .deb, .rpm and AppImage, for x64 and ARM64 See the tray note below.

Homebrew

brew tap chen08209/tap
brew install --cask flclash

Linux tray icon

The tray icon is a StatusNotifierItem. KDE Plasma, XFCE and most panels show it as is; GNOME needs the AppIndicator and KStatusNotifierItem Support extension.

Unattended desktop

FlClash starts the core only after the disclaimer is accepted. Where nobody can click it, such as a container, set FLCLASH_ACCEPT_DISCLAIMER=1 in the app's environment to accept it on first launch.

Usage

Import a profile from a link. Opening a link in this form imports the subscription into FlClash. The clashmeta:// and flclash:// schemes work the same way.

clash://install-config?url=<URL-encoded subscription link>

Automate on Android. Tasker, MacroDroid and similar apps can start, stop or toggle the proxy by starting an activity with one of these actions:

com.follow.clash.action.START
com.follow.clash.action.STOP
com.follow.clash.action.TOGGLE

From a computer, the same works over adb:

adb shell am start -a com.follow.clash.action.TOGGLE

Build from source

You need Flutter 3.50 (release builds use 3.50.0), Go 1.27 and Rust installed through rustup. Each platform builds on its own host, except Android, which builds anywhere.

git clone --recursive https://github.com/chen08209/FlClash.git
cd FlClash
flutter pub get
dart run tool/package.dart android   # or windows, macos, linux

Packages land in dist/. The Go core and the Rust libraries are compiled as part of the Flutter build.

Platform Also needed
Android Android SDK with the NDK. Add --arch arm64 to build a single ABI.
Windows GCC (MinGW-w64) for the core and Inno Setup 6 for the installer.
macOS Xcode and Node.js. The script installs appdmg through npm.
Linux Debian or Ubuntu. The script installs the build packages with apt and downloads appimagetool.

Run dart run tool/package.dart --help for the remaining options, such as --targets to build only some package formats or --dry-run to list the files a run would write.

Support

Starring the repository is the easiest way to support the project. Questions and announcements go to the Telegram channel; bugs and feature requests go to GitHub Issues.

License

FlClash is released under the GPL-3.0 license.

item.title: hiddify/hiddify-app
item.description:
Multi-platform auto-proxy client, supporting Sing-box, X-ray, TUIC, Hysteria, Reality, Trojan, SSH etc. It’s an open-source, secure and ad-free.

https://hiddify.com

فارسی 🇮🇷 / Русский 🇷🇺 / 简体中文 🇨🇳 / 日本語 🇯🇵 / Português-BR 🇧🇷



What is the Hiddify app?

The Hiddify app is a free, open-source and ad-free proxy and VPN client for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. It is built on sing-box and works with almost every protocol and subscription format, so you can use it with any proxy panel, including Hiddify Manager.

🚀 Main features

  • ✈️ One app on every device: Android (phones and Android TV), iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux.
  • 🎁 Free profiles: connect without a server of your own with the built-in free WARP and Psiphon profiles.
  • 🟡 Many protocols: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Reality, Shadowsocks, Hysteria2, TUIC, WireGuard, SSH, AnyTLS and more, with the latest Xray-core and sing-box features such as VLESS encryption.
  • 🔗 Every subscription format: sing-box, V2Ray (Base64 or plain links), Clash and Clash Meta, with automatic subscription updates.
  • 🔍 Automatic server choice: the app tests every server and picks the fastest one; you can also choose a server yourself.
  • 🛡 Extra security and proxy unblocker options for countries with strong filtering, with ready rules for Iran, China, Russia and other regions.
  • 🔀 VPN or proxy mode, per-app routing on Android, and connection sharing with other devices on your network.
  • 📊 Profile details: remaining days and data for each subscription.
  • 🌍 30 languages, dark and light themes.
  • 💻 HiddifyCli for servers and computers without a desktop.
  • ⭐ Open source, secure and community driven, available on the official stores.

item.title: flutter/flutter
item.description:
Flutter makes it easy and fast to build beautiful apps for mobile and beyond

https://flutter.dev

Flutter is Google's SDK for crafting beautiful, fast user experiences for mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase. Flutter works with existing code, is used by developers and organizations around the world, and is free and open source.

Documentation

  • Install Flutter
  • Flutter documentation
  • Development wiki
  • Contributing to Flutter

For release and other announcements, join the flutter-announce mailing list. Our documentation also tracks breaking changes across releases.

Terms of service

The Flutter tool may occasionally download resources from Google servers. By downloading or using the Flutter SDK, you agree to the Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

For example, when installed from GitHub (as opposed to from a prepackaged archive), the Flutter tool will download the Dart SDK from Google servers immediately when first run, as it is used to execute the flutter tool itself. This will also occur when Flutter is upgraded (e.g. by running the flutter upgrade command).

About Flutter

We think Flutter will help you create beautiful, fast apps, with a productive, extensible and open development model, whether you're targeting iOS or Android, web, Windows, macOS, Linux or embedding it as the UI toolkit for a platform of your choice.

Beautiful user experiences

We want to enable designers to deliver their full creative vision without being forced to water it down due to limitations of the underlying framework. Flutter's layered architecture gives you control over every pixel on the screen and its powerful compositing capabilities let you overlay and animate graphics, video, text, and controls without limitation. Flutter includes a full set of widgets that deliver pixel-perfect experiences whether you're building for iOS (Cupertino) or other platforms (Material), along with support for customizing or creating entirely new visual components.

Fast results

Flutter is fast. It's powered by hardware-accelerated 2D graphics libraries like Skia (which underpins Chrome and Android) and Impeller. We architected Flutter to support glitch-free, jank-free graphics at the native speed of your device.

Flutter code is powered by the world-class Dart programming language, which enables compilation to 32-bit and 64-bit ARM machine code for iOS and Android, JavaScript and WebAssembly for the web, as well as Intel x64 and ARM for desktop devices.

Productive development

Flutter offers stateful hot reload, allowing you to make changes to your code and see the results instantly without restarting your app or losing its state.

Extensible and open model

Flutter works with any development tool (or none at all), and also includes editor plug-ins for both Visual Studio Code and IntelliJ / Android Studio. Flutter provides tens of thousands of packages to speed your development, regardless of your target platform. And accessing other native code is easy, with support for both FFI (on Android, on iOS, on macOS, on Linux, and on Windows) as well as platform-specific APIs.

Flutter is a fully open-source project, and we welcome contributions. Information on how to get started can be found in our contributor guide.

item.description:
An open-source cross-platform alternative to AirDrop

https://localsend.org

LocalSend

Homepage • Discord • GitHub • Codeberg

English (Default) • 中文

LocalSend is a free, open-source app that allows you to securely share files and messages with nearby devices over your local network without needing an internet connection.

  • About
  • Sponsors

  • Dependency Hierarchy

    • Android

    • macOS

About

LocalSend is a cross-platform app that enables secure communication between devices using a REST API and HTTPS encryption. Unlike other messaging apps that rely on external servers, LocalSend doesn't require an internet connection or third-party servers, making it a fast and reliable solution for local communication.

Sponsors

This project is tested with BrowserStack

Supported by TestMu AI

Screenshots

Download

It is recommended to download the app either from an app store or from a package manager because the app does not have an auto-update.

Windows macOS Linux Android iOS Fire OS
Winget App Store Flathub Play Store App Store Amazon
Scoop Homebrew Nixpkgs F-Droid
Chocolatey DMG Installer Snap APK
EXE Installer AUR
Portable ZIP TAR
DEB
AppImage

Read more about distribution channels.

Windows binaries are signed. Read more about the Code signing policy.

Caution

Unofficial MSIX preview: you can try builds from the latest commits at localsend.ob-buff.dev. Stability is not guaranteed and all custom code tweaks are listed on that site.

Compatibility

Platform Minimum Version Note
Android 7.0 The last version to support Android 5 and 6 is v1.17.0.
iOS 13.0 The last version to support iOS 12 is v1.17.0. Sharing from other apps requires iOS 14 or later.
macOS 11 Big Sur Use OpenCore Legacy Patcher 2.0.2 (See #1005)
Windows 10 The last version to support Windows 7 is v1.15.4.
Linux N.A. Deps: Gnome: xdg-desktop-portal and xdg-desktop-portal-gtk, KDE: xdg-desktop-portal and xdg-desktop-portal-kde

Setup

In most cases, LocalSend should work out of the box. However, if you are having trouble sending or receiving files, you may need to configure your firewall to allow LocalSend to communicate over your local network.

Traffic Type Protocol Port Action
Incoming TCP, UDP 53317 Allow
Outgoing TCP, UDP Any Allow

On Linux, for example with ufw: sudo ufw allow 53317. With firewalld: sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/tcp, sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=53317/udp, then sudo firewall-cmd --reload.

Also make sure to disable AP isolation on your router. It should be usually disabled by default but some routers may have it enabled (especially guest networks). See troubleshooting for more information.

Portable Mode

(Introduced in v1.13.0)

Create a file named settings.json located in the same directory as the executable. This file can be empty. The app will use this file to store settings instead of the default location.

Start hidden

(Updated in v1.15.0)

To start the app hidden (only in tray), use the --hidden flag (example: localsend_app.exe --hidden).

On v1.14.0 and earlier, the app starts hidden if autostart flag is set, and the hidden setting is enabled.

How It Works

LocalSend uses a secure communication protocol that allows devices to communicate with each other using a REST API. All data is sent securely over HTTPS, and the TLS/SSL certificate is generated on the fly on each device, ensuring maximum security.

For more information on the LocalSend Protocol, see the documentation.

Dependency Hierarchy

Getting Started

To compile LocalSend from the source code, follow these steps:

  1. Install Flutter directly or using fvm (see version required)
  2. Install Rust
  3. Clone the LocalSend repository
  4. Run cd app to enter the app directory
  5. Run flutter pub get to download dependencies
  6. Run flutter run to start the app

Note

LocalSend currently requires an older Flutter version (specified in .fvmrc) and thus build issues may be caused by a mismatch between the required and the (system-wide) installed Flutter version.
To make development more consistent, LocalSend uses fvm to manage the project Flutter version. After installing fvm, run fvm flutter instead of flutter.

Command Line Interface

The LocalSend CLI is a terminal client built on LocalSend Protocol v2.

On macOS and Linux, install the CLI with Homebrew:

brew update
brew install localsend-cli

To upgrade an existing installation:

brew update
brew upgrade localsend-cli

Run localsend-cli --help to see every available option and hotkey.

Use the send command with one or more files, directories, or a mixture of both:

localsend-cli send report.pdf photo.jpg ./project-backup

The command opens the discovered-device list; select the destination interactively and press Enter to start the transfer.

To select the destination without an interactive device list, pass its exact alias or IP address:

localsend-cli send --to "Cute Tomato" report.pdf
localsend-cli send --to 192.168.27.26 report.pdf

An alias must uniquely identify a discovered device. An IP address is probed directly over HTTPS on LocalSend's default port (53317).

To send a text message instead of files, use --text together with --to. Pass - to read the text from stdin:

localsend-cli send --to "Cute Tomato" --text "https://localsend.org"
echo "Hello" | localsend-cli send --to "Cute Tomato" --text -

A single trailing line break is dropped from stdin. Text longer than 64 KB is sent as a .txt file instead. Stdin must be UTF-8 and at most 16 MB; send other data as a file.

Directories are collected recursively. Their selected root names and nested paths are preserved on the receiver. Empty directories are not sent because LocalSend transfers file entries rather than directory entries.

Contributing

We welcome contributions from anyone interested in helping improve LocalSend. If you'd like to contribute, there are a few ways to get involved:

Translation

You can help translate LocalSend into other languages. We use the Weblate platform to manage translations.

Alternatively, you can also contribute by forking this repository and adding translations manually.

The translations are located in the app/assets/i18n directory. Edit the _missing_translations_<locale>.json or strings_<locale>.i18n.json file to add or update translations.

Take note: Fields decorated with @ are not meant to be translated; they are not used in the app in any way, being merely informative text about the file or to give context to the translator.

Bug Fixes and Improvements

  • Bug Fixes: If you find a bug, please create a pull request with a clear description of the issue and how to fix it.
  • Improvements: Have an idea for how to improve LocalSend? Please create an issue first to discuss why the improvement is needed.

For more information, see the contributing guide.

Troubleshooting

Issue Platform (Sending) Platform (Receiving) Solution
Device not visible Any Any Make sure to disable AP-Isolation on your router. If it is enabled, connections between devices are forbidden.
Device not visible Any Windows Make sure to configure your network as a "private" network. Windows might be more restrictive when the network is configured as public.
Device not visible macOS, iOS Any You can try to toggle the "Local Network" permission under "Privacy" in the OS settings.
Device not visible Any Any If a VPN is active, allow local/LAN traffic or temporarily disable the VPN. Some VPNs block local network connections by default.
Device not visible Any Any Use manual sending to enter the receiver's IP address directly. If that works, add the device to favorites so it is probed directly.
Speed too slow Any Any Use 5 Ghz; Disable encryption on both devices
Speed too slow Any Android Known issue. https://github.com/flutter-cavalry/saf_stream/issues/4

Building

These commands are intended for maintainers only. Make sure to run them from the app directory.

Android

Traditional APK

flutter build apk

AppBundle for Google Play

flutter build appbundle

iOS

flutter build ipa

macOS

flutter build macos

Windows

Traditional

flutter build windows

Local MSIX App

flutter pub run msix:create

Store ready

flutter pub run msix:create --store

Linux

Traditional

flutter build linux

AppImage

appimage-builder --recipe AppImageBuilder.yml

Snap

Instructions in localsend/snap/README.md

item.description:
文析助手，一个跨平台的聚合网盘解析与管理软件，目前支持17家主流网盘解析。已支持安卓，iOS，Windows，macOS端

文析助手 · AsterLink

把网盘放在一起，在手机与电脑上完成解析、搜索、传输和播放。

安卓界面 · Windows 界面 · 支持网盘 · 功能 · 下载 · 编译 · 更新记录

项目介绍

文析助手（AsterLink） 是一款免费、开源的跨平台网盘管理、资源搜索与文件传输应用，支持 Android、Windows、iOS / iPadOS 和 macOS，已接入 17 个网盘。 粘贴分享链接、提取码或网盘口令，即可浏览目录、下载文件和在线播放；也可以搜索公开分享，按链接有效性筛选资源。登录账号后，可管理个人网盘、切换多个账号、搜索文件、上传文件夹，并收藏常用文件和分享。

下载与上传集中在「传输」页，支持 HTTP / HTTPS、磁力、BT 种子和 ED2K 文件链接；手机与电脑可通过局域网互传文字、链接、文件和文件夹。内置播放器提供断点续播、片头片尾跳过、字幕、截图和布局自定义，还可选择外部播放器或连接支持 DLNA 的电视。主题、液态玻璃效果和日夜背景均可调整。

手机界面

单页原图：分享解析 · 网盘管理 · 传输管理 · 我的设置

电脑端界面

单页原图：分享解析 · 网盘列表 · 传输管理 · 我的设置

支持网盘

17 个网盘 + GitHub 文件源，其中 15 个网盘支持分享链接解析；GitHub 另支持仓库文件与 Releases 链接。


夸克网盘
UC 网盘
迅雷云盘

百度网盘
123 云盘
中国移动云盘

天翼云盘
光鸭云盘
阿里云盘

蓝奏云
中国联通云盘
115 网盘

城通网盘
蓝奏云优享版
仅个人网盘管理
腾讯微云
仅个人网盘管理

小飞机网盘
PikPak
GitHub 文件源
仓库文件与发布附件

网盘列表支持自定义排序和隐藏，账号可自定义名称并保留配置。蓝奏云优享版与腾讯微云目前提供个人文件管理，暂不支持分享链接解析；文件操作和下载能力以对应平台与账号权限为准。

功能

功能 可以做什么
链接与口令解析 识别完整分享文案、提取码与多条链接，保留解析历史；夸克、迅雷、UC、移动提供独立口令入口，选择平台后解析并进入文件列表，部分口令需要登录对应网盘账号。
公开资源搜索 按关键词搜索公开分享，支持网盘分类、包含词、排除词与优先可解析筛选；链接检测后逐批显示，按「有效 → 无法检测 → 失效」排序，浏览时保持已显示结果的位置。
多网盘、多账号 快速切换账号、自定义账号名称，查看和复制该账号的登录信息；下载、播放与收藏保留账号归属。
文件管理与搜索 列表或网格浏览，名称、大小、时间均可正序或倒序排列，名称支持中文拼音与数字自然排序；文件夹置顶，返回上级目录恢复滚动位置。支持多选、新建文件夹及平台允许的重命名、移动、删除与分享；账号内搜索支持类型筛选、搜索历史及子目录搜索。
存储空间切换 阿里云盘可切换资源库、备份盘与相册；支持的移动、天翼和联通账号可浏览家庭云。
统一下载管理 支持网盘文件、HTTP / HTTPS、磁力链接、BT 种子与 ED2K 文件链接，提供暂停、继续、失败自动重试、批量操作及连接数、任务数和限速设置。BT 支持 Tracker 检测、找源缓存、上传限速、来源状态显示和连续下载同种子文件时复用连接。
文件与文件夹上传 支持的平台可上传整个文件夹，保留子目录和空目录；Windows / macOS 支持拖入文件或文件夹。任务独立排队，离开文件页面仍可继续，在「传输 → 上传」查看进度、取消或重试；继续文件夹任务时跳过已完成文件。详见 文件夹上传。
预览与在线播放 预览图片、文本和 PDF；PDF 与 Office 文档可调用在线查看器（需确认向第三方提交临时链接和文件内容）。播放器支持断点续播、播放列表、倍速、音轨与字幕、截图、定时停止、画面比例和字幕外观；支持的任务可边下边播。
播放手势与布局 自定义片头片尾跳过时长、视频缩放、控制按钮显示和面板布局，可在当前视频画面上调整布局；长按默认 2 倍播放，左右滑动每档调整 0.5 倍，上滑锁定、下滑取消。
外部播放与小窗 记住多条外部播放器使用记录，支持快速选择。Android 支持系统画中画，Windows / macOS 支持多个独立视频窗口，可继续操作主界面；iOS 当前不提供画中画，外部播放支持已安装的 Infuse / VLC，受视频链接访问方式限制。
电视投屏 支持局域网 DLNA / UPnP 接收设备，投屏后可控制播放、暂停、进度和切集；设备支持时可调节电视音量。Apple 平台可手动输入电视地址，投屏期间需保持应用运行。
设备互联 同一局域网内互传文字、链接、文件和文件夹，支持扫码连接、选择已连接设备发送、收件箱回复，以及限时文件链接与二维码分享。
安卓传输悬浮窗 同时查看下载、上传进度，支持拖动、调整宽高和收起为悬浮球；闲置 3 秒自动贴边半隐藏。
收藏与重命名 收藏分享链接、文件和文件夹，自定义收藏名称；保留提取码，快速重新解析分享或定位文件目录。
主题与背景 五套配色，液态玻璃、磨砂、实色三种效果，支持浅色、深色和跟随系统；自定义日夜背景、亮度、模糊和卡片透明度，分别记住手机与电脑的裁剪位置。可选择实色效果减少滤镜开销，折射效果取决于设备渲染支持。
备份与恢复 导出账号、设置和收藏，可选择携带背景图片。新版备份为明文并带完整性校验，无需密码；导入旧加密备份时仍需原密码。本地数据兼容旧版迁移，备份含登录凭据，请妥善保管。

不同网盘的接口、账号权益和网络环境会影响下载速度与功能可用性，连接数也会按平台限制调整。设备互联需处于可互通的局域网；手机端可扫码或手动输入地址，macOS 当前使用连接码或手动地址。

Android 可通过通知栏和传输悬浮窗查看后台任务；桌面端传输期间需保持应用运行。iOS 的后台传输受系统挂起规则限制，长时间下载建议保持应用在前台。iOS / macOS 的安装与功能差异见 iOS 说明 和 macOS 说明。

使用

  1. 管理网盘：需要浏览个人文件时，在“网盘”页选择平台并登录；按需调整排序、隐藏平台或添加多个账号。

  4. 管理任务：在“传输”页切换下载和上传任务，查看进度并进行暂停、取消、重试等操作；安卓端也可手动开启传输悬浮窗。

Dart

An approachable, portable, and productive language for high-quality apps on any platform

Dart is:

  • Approachable: Develop with a strongly typed programming language that is consistent, concise, and offers modern language features like null safety and patterns.

  • Portable: Compile to ARM, x64, or RISC-V machine code for mobile, desktop, and backend. Compile to JavaScript or WebAssembly for the web.

  • Productive: Make changes iteratively: use hot reload to see the result instantly in your running app. Diagnose app issues using DevTools.

Dart's flexible compiler technology lets you run Dart code in different ways, depending on your target platform and goals:

  • Dart Native: For programs targeting devices (mobile, desktop, server, and more), Dart Native includes both a Dart VM with JIT (just-in-time) compilation and an AOT (ahead-of-time) compiler for producing machine code.

  • Dart Web: For programs targeting the web, Dart Web includes both a development time compiler (dartdevc) and a production time compiler (dart2js).

item.title: Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core
item.description:
A premium Jellyfin Client for Android Mobile, Android TV, iOS, Linux, MacOS, tvOS, Web, and Windows

https://moonfin.io

Moonfin

Premium Jellyfin, Emby, Plex & Silo client for mobile, tablet, desktop, TV, and web

← Back to main Moonfin project

Moonfin is a media client for Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and Silo servers, built with Flutter. One shared codebase powers phones and tablets, Windows, macOS, and Linux, Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV, and the browser. It's made for people who want a modern, customizable experience on every screen they own.

Where to get it

Platform Download
Android Mobile / TV
Fire TV
iOS
Linux

macOS
tvOS
Windows


or winget install Moonfin.Moonfin

Supported Servers

Server Minimum Version Status
Jellyfin 10.8.0+ Full support
Emby 4.8.0.0+ Full support (the admin panel needs 4.9+)
Plex Plex Media Server 1.43+ Supported. Moonbase features need the Moonbase for Plex companion
Silo API v2 (api_major 2) Supported through Silo's native API, see below

Silo

Moonfin talks to Silo through its native API (/api/v2), not its Jellyfin-compatible service. Add the server by its native address, which is port 8090 with Silo's Docker Compose setup or 8080 without Docker. If you enter the Jellyfin-compatible address on port 8096, Moonfin offers to connect to Silo directly, or you can keep it as a Jellyfin server. Silo servers on your local network also show up under Discovered Servers, except on web.

Sign-in with a password or a code, Home, libraries, search, favorites, watched state, ratings, collections, playback, skip intro and credits, trickplay, household profiles with their PINs, and downloads with offline progress sync all work.

Requests use Silo's own requests feature in place of Seerr, and Watch Parties use Silo's own watch party rooms. Settings sync, admin defaults, server messages, custom themes and MDBList and TMDB ratings need Moonbase for Silo, installed from Plugins > Catalog in Silo's admin pages.

Live TV and DVR, music, playlists, remote control of other devices, the server admin panel (Silo's is in its web app) and retro games aren't available on Silo, so Moonfin hides them while a Silo server is active. Books, audiobooks, 4K requests and Silo's server-side download subscriptions aren't supported yet.

If a Silo server has a newer API than your version of Moonfin, Moonfin won't connect to it and asks you to update Moonfin.

Platform Support

Platform Minimum Version Status
Android 7.0 (API 24) Full support
Android TV / Google TV Android 7.0 (API 24) Full support
Fire TV Fire OS 6 Full support
iOS 18.0 Full support
Apple TV (tvOS) 18.0 Full support
macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) Full support
Windows 10 (x64 and ARM64) Full support
Linux Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13, Fedora 39, or any distro with glibc 2.38. Older ones like Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm can use Flathub Full support (Wayland and X11)
Web Modern browsers (installable PWA) Full support

Android TV, Fire TV, and Apple TV ship from this same codebase with a TV-tuned interface and D-pad navigation. Fire TV runs the same native backend as Android TV. Web runs as an installable PWA through the Moonbase server plugin.

Features

  • One codebase, every screen. Phones, tablets, desktop, Android TV, Apple TV, and web, with navigation tuned for touch, pointer, and remote.
  • Playback that just works. Wide codec support including AV1, HEVC, Dolby Vision, Dolby Atmos, HDR10+, and audio passthrough. Dolby Vision Profile 7 direct plays on Apple and Android TV, converted in real time instead of transcoded, with most of a FEL file's enhancement layer kept on Apple devices, and Windows can send HDR to the display untouched. Two subtitle tracks can show at once on every player. See Playback and Codecs.
  • A mini player on desktop that keeps the video playing in a bar along the bottom while you browse.
  • Offline downloads in original or smaller server-transcoded quality, with automatic folder organization, offline subtitles, automatic downloads of new episodes for the series you follow, and Smart downloads on phones and tablets that keep the next episodes of a show downloaded and clear them once watched. See Downloads.
  • Ebooks and audiobooks. Read EPUB, MOBI, AZW/AZW3, PDF, and comic archives, with your reading progress synced to the server. Play M4B audiobooks with chapter navigation.
  • Retro games browsed and played in-app from a server game library, with gamepad support, save states and battery saves that sync between devices, hardware rendering on Android, and RomM-backed libraries you browse with your own RomM account. See Retro Games.
  • Multi-server unified library that merges several servers into one browsable, searchable UI, and can fold every server's movies and shows, Plex and Silo included, into one Movies and one TV Shows library.
  • Library styles for video, music, and book libraries, from the classic grid to a docked side panel, an immersive music hero, or a bookstore shelf.
  • A setup wizard on first run that asks how you want the app to look, with live previews built from your own artwork, and a Settings screen that previews each change live.
  • Nine detail screen styles to pick from: Classic, Modern, Spotlight, Nouveau, Minimalist, Stage, Premiere, Quick Look, and Frost.
  • Featured media bar with six layouts, a New Releases source that labels new movies and episodes, and optional in-bar trailer previews.
  • Themes and a Theme Store with a built-in editor, server-side sync, and an OLED mode for true blacks, plus custom loading animations and a screensaver on TV.
  • An integrated admin panel for Jellyfin and Emby, covering settings, users, libraries, Live TV, logs, devices, and analytics, plus a messages window for notes from your server admin.
  • Discovery with Seerr built into the details screen, with trending, popular, and upcoming rows and request status overlays.
  • Smart Search that finds titles from a plain sentence, poster labels like 4K and HDR, and a Calendar of what's coming up in Sonarr and Radarr with reminders on phones and tablets, all served by the Moonbase plugin.
  • Live TV and DVR with a program guide, rewind on channels that keep a rewind window, a quick channel changer on TV, automatic recovery when a channel stalls, and recording management.
  • Client certificates (mTLS) for servers that require one, with a page you open on your phone to send the certificate to a TV.
  • Trickplay scrubbing as a single thumbnail, a filmstrip, or full screen, on both Jellyfin and Emby.
  • Cinema Mode and segment skipping for pre-rolls, intros, credits, and SponsorBlock.
  • Casting and remote control over Google Cast, DLNA, and AirPlay, plus control of other Jellyfin devices on your network with a D-pad and search typed from your phone. Other Jellyfin apps can steer Moonfin too.
  • Watch Parties with chat, reactions, invite links, and voting on what to watch. Moonbase hosts them on Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex, Silo hosts its own, and SyncPlay is still there on Jellyfin.
  • Personal ratings as a like, five stars, or a score out of ten, usable to sort or filter a library.
  • Kids Mode that strips the app back to what a child needs and locks the way out with a PIN, plus blocked ratings that apply everywhere in the app.
  • Achievement Badges drawn natively when your Jellyfin server runs the Achievement Badges plugin, including its friends list and chat.
  • Anime markers for filler, recap, canon, and subbed or dubbed episodes, served by the Moonbase plugin.
  • Home rows your way, in Classic, Modern or Carousel style, with IMDb, TMDB, MDBList and streaming service charts, Seerr rows, and a seasonal holiday row. See Home Rows.
  • Privacy built in. Crash reports only go to your own server, push notifications only start when your server can send them, and logs scrub addresses and tokens. See Where Your Data Is Stored.
  • Ratings from MDBList and TMDB, and in-app update checks.

The full list is on the Features wiki page.

Screenshots

TV and desktop

Mobile

Installation

The store links above are the easy route. To install a file yourself, download it from the Releases page and pick the one for your device:

Platform File
Android phones, tablets, Android TV, Google TV and Fire TV Moonfin_Android_v<version>.apk
iOS Moonfin_iOS_v<version>_unsigned.ipa (for self-signing)
Apple TV Moonfin_tvOS_v<version>_unsigned.ipa (for self-signing)
Windows x64 Moonfin_Windows_v<version>.exe
Windows ARM64 Moonfin_WindowsARM64_v<version>.exe
macOS Moonfin_macOS_v<version>.dmg
Linux x64 Moonfin_Linux_v<version>.<ext> (AppImage, deb, rpm, snap, flatpak, tarball)
Linux ARM64 Moonfin_LinuxARM64_v<version>.<ext> (same formats)
Web Served as a PWA by the Moonbase server plugin, no download needed

On Linux, the easiest route is Flathub with flatpak install flathub io.moonfin.moonfin. It's also the way to go on Raspberry Pi OS Bookworm and other Debian 12 systems, which the release files don't run on. On Arch Linux, install from the AUR with yay -S moonfin-bin (or paru -S moonfin-bin, pamac build moonfin-bin).

Click-by-click steps for every platform are on Installation, and Getting Started covers connecting to your server for the first time.

Building

Flutter stable 3.47 or newer is the one thing every platform needs (Dart 3.13 comes with it). Each target also needs its own toolchain: Android Studio with the SDK and NDK for Android, Xcode and CocoaPods for iOS and macOS, the flutter-tvos toolchain for Apple TV, Visual Studio and vcpkg for Windows, and a handful of development packages on Linux. Every Android command also takes a --flavor.

git clone https://github.com/Moonfin-Client/Moonfin-Core.git
cd Moonfin-Core
flutter pub get

The per-platform build commands are on Building from Source.

Documentation

The deeper reference material lives in the Wiki:

Page What it covers
Features The full feature list, section by section
Playback and Codecs The backend per platform, the codec table, HDR, and audio passthrough
Downloads Original and transcoded downloads, quality presets, and storage paths

Common Problems Plain fixes for connection, login, playback, sound, subtitle, download and casting trouble
Collecting Logs Capturing a diagnostic report for a bug report
Custom mpv Configuration Tuning playback with your own mpv.conf, allowed options, and SVP on Windows
Building from Source Toolchain versions, step by step setup, and the build commands for every platform
Development Developer notes, contributing guidelines, and the pull request process

Contributing

Contributions are welcome. Check the existing issues first, discuss major feature changes before implementing them, match the existing code style, run flutter analyze, and test on at least one target platform. Keep pull requests focused and include context, screenshots or logs where useful.

See CONTRIBUTING.md for the full guidelines and the pull request process.

Tap the muscles you want to train, log your sets and watch your numbers go up.



       

English · Español · Italiano · 简体中文



Plain screenshots, every screen straight off the phone

Today  ·  Body map  ·  Live session  ·  Progress



History  ·  Library  ·  Routines  ·  Settings

What it does

Training

  • Tap the muscles on a body map and get a session
  • Reps, weight and a rest timer with your own sound
  • Warm-up, drop, failure, rest-pause and cluster sets, with RPE or RIR
  • Supersets and plates per side
  • Routines, weekly plans and rotations, with days off that keep your streak
  • Progression per exercise, deload weeks and light sessions
  • A voice that guides your rest (beta)

Progress

  • Volume, streaks, weekly goal and records for every rep range
  • Strength curves with estimated 1RM and strength per bodyweight
  • An activity heatmap and a muscle map of what you trained
  • Your month, recapped, as a story and a card to share
  • Progress photos on a timeline
  • Bodyweight, ten body measurements, steps, sleep and heart rate
  • Levels, medals and a sticker to share your workout

Exercises and tools

  • 500+ exercises with animations and instructions
  • Browse by muscle, equipment or level, or add your own
  • Use your own photo, GIF or video for any exercise
  • Places: tell it your kit and it only suggests what fits
  • A training journal with photos and video
  • Twelve calculators, five widgets and an NFC sticker that opens today's workout

Your data

  • CSV export and a full ZIP backup
  • Import from Hevy, Strong, Lyfta, Liftosaur, JEFIT, StrongLifts, FitNotes or openGym
  • Health Connect in and out, and workouts to Strava as a .fit file
  • No account, no ads, no analytics, no internet permission
  • 22 languages, light and dark, kg or lb
  • Delete everything in one tap

Nutrition (beta)

Calories and macros against your goal, 500+ foods with photos, your own foods and dishes, water, supplements with dose and stock, meal plans and meal prep. Ask any AI for a meal, paste its answer and GymMane turns it into real food, with nothing sent from the app. No scanner and no online database. Don't need it? Turn it off in Settings › Beta.

Download

Get it from F-Droid, IzzyOnDroid, OpenAPK, Obtainium or the GitHub releases. Not sure which APK? Take arm64-v8a.

Platform Status
Android 7.0+ Supported
Web, self-hosted Supported, see SELFHOST.md
Wear OS 3+ Beta, see WEAR.md
iOS 15+ In progress

Self-hosted

The full app also runs in the browser from your own server, laid out for big screens, with your data in one folder on that machine:

curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InlitX/GymMane/main/compose.yaml
docker compose up -d

No Docker? There are one-line installers for Linux, macOS, Windows and Proxmox VE, a template for Unraid and a compose file you can paste into Synology, QNAP, TrueNAS, CasaOS or Portainer. Everything, including syncing with the phone through Syncthing, is in SELFHOST.md.

Privacy

GymMane doesn't have the internet permission, so your training never leaves your phone. The permissions it asks for are for the rest timer, its notification and the widgets.

Contributing

Bug reports, ideas and pull requests are welcome. For anything big, open an issue first. Want to translate? Edit your language's file and send a pull request, TRANSLATING.md shows how.

git clone https://github.com/InlitX/GymMane.git

item.description:
VeneraNext 是一个跨平台漫画阅读器，支持本地漫画、WebDAV 漫画源、第三方网络漫画源，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、Linux、macOS 平台。

VeneraNext

1. 项目介绍

VeneraNext 是基于 Venera 持续开发的 Flutter 漫画阅读器，支持 Android、Android TV、Windows、Linux、iOS 和 macOS，另提供 HarmonyOS 测试版。

本分支围绕“少一点打断，多一点阅读”打磨日常体验：瀑布流跨章连读不用退出，长按收藏省去选择收藏夹的步骤，夜间和墨水屏设备各有阅读设置。本地导入、离线下载、阅读统计与多设备同步，让找书、看漫画和追连载更方便。

原项目的 JavaScript 漫画源扩展、本地阅读、搜索与分类、收藏下载，以及按源提供的登录、评论和评分能力继续保留。

快速入口： 下载安装 · 使用说明 · 编写漫画源 · JavaScript API · 更新日志

Important

本仓库只维护阅读器本体和扩展运行环境，不提供、内置、托管或推荐漫画源。网络漫画源需由用户自行合法配置，具体内容及源站可用性由相应扩展和服务决定。

1.1 软件截图

主页：阅读历史、稍后阅读与追更 漫画详情页

2. 功能亮点

2.1 一键追更

默认设置下，在漫画详情页长按“收藏”按钮，作品就会加入“追更”收藏夹，不用再选文件夹。应用会自动检查更新，在首页集中显示更新数量和作品封面；点封面进入详情，再点“阅读”或“继续阅读”即可开读。

新装应用会自动建好“追更”收藏夹。想更换快捷收藏或追更的目标收藏夹，具体入口见收藏、稍后阅读与追更。

2.2 阅读体验

  • 瀑布流跨章阅读（非 TV 默认模式）：看完整章不用退出再选下一章——接近章末自动接上下一章，往上滚也能回到已加载的上一章，进度记录在你实际看到的位置。
  • Android TV 与盒子：独立电视安装包、横屏启动入口、遥控器方向键导航与可见焦点；默认启用单页低内存阅读，可与手机版共存。
  • 纵向拆分双页：横向双页图在手机上会被压得很小？在纵向连续/瀑布流模式里开启“拆分双页”，把左右两半上下排列着看，顺序不合适还可以交换。
  • 夜间调光：在阅读器内把画面调暗，方便夜间阅读，不改动系统亮度。
  • 电子墨水屏刷新：画廊模式按翻页间隔闪屏，帮助减少残影，间隔和样式可调。
  • 更顺手的详情页：下载、阅读/继续阅读更好找，章节进度与更新提示一目了然，上次选择的章节正序/倒序也会保留。

2.3 找书、收藏与数据

  • 稍后阅读：把准备以后看的漫画放进单独列表，首页就能找到。
  • 本地漫画库：图片文件夹、CBZ/ZIP/7Z/CB7、PDF、图片型 EPUB 导入即可阅读，支持章节子目录和自然排序，本地漫画还能导出成 CBZ 备份。
  • WebDAV：同步、备份、NAS 阅读：同步多设备的设置、收藏和阅读进度，备份本地漫画，或在线阅读 NAS 图片目录；三种用途分别配置。
  • 阅读统计：记录你实际看漫画的时间，历史页查看累计时长、读过的作品数和时长排行。
  • 收藏画廊与搜索快捷方式：收藏页可切换封面画廊，常搜的作者/标签可保存为快捷方式，收藏的图片也能按漫画浏览。

2.4 延续 Venera 的核心能力

  • 开放的扩展接口：用 JavaScript 对接漫画服务，按源提供搜索、聚合搜索、探索页、分类、排行和标签翻译。
  • 多种阅读方式：画廊分页、章节内连续滚动、缩放与多图布局，支持触摸、键盘及移动端音量键操作。
  • 收藏与离线阅读：本地收藏、网络收藏、历史记录、图片收藏和下载队列，下载的章节可离线阅读。
  • 按源启用的互动：登录、Cookie、评论回复、点赞和评分等，由扩展实际支持的能力决定。
  • 跨设备使用：WebDAV 数据同步与导入导出，以及可供脚本调用的无头命令模式。

3. 下载安装

3.1 Android 手机与平板

从 最新稳定版 下载 APK 安装包：

文件名 说明 适用场景
VeneraNext-xxx-android.apk 通用版 适用于大多数 Android 设备
VeneraNext-xxx-android-arm64-v8a.apk ARM64 版 支持 ARM64 应用的 Android 设备
VeneraNext-xxx-android-armeabi-v7a.apk ARM32 版 较老的 32 位设备
VeneraNext-xxx-android-x86_64.apk x86_64 版 x86_64 设备或模拟器

推荐：如果不确定应该下载哪个，选择通用版 VeneraNext-xxx-android.apk。

3.2 Android TV

从 最新稳定版 下载 TV APK 安装包：

文件名 说明 适用场景
VeneraNext-xxx-android-tv.apk TV 通用版 适用于大多数 Android 电视或盒子
VeneraNext-xxx-android-tv-arm64-v8a.apk TV ARM64 版 支持 ARM64 应用的电视或盒子
VeneraNext-xxx-android-tv-armeabi-v7a.apk TV ARM32 版 32 位系统的电视或盒子
VeneraNext-xxx-android-tv-x86_64.apk TV x86_64 版 x86_64 设备或模拟器

推荐：如果不确定应该下载哪个，选择通用版 VeneraNext-xxx-android-tv.apk。

将 APK 传到电视后侧载，启动器名称为 VeneraNext TV，可与手机版共存，数据独立。

操作说明见 TV 遥控器与低内存阅读，安装与升级详情见 Android TV 分发说明。

3.3 Windows

推荐通过 winget 安装，后续可以直接使用同一包 ID 升级：

winget install --id CyrilPeng.VeneraNext --exact
winget upgrade --id CyrilPeng.VeneraNext --exact

也可以从 最新稳定版 下载 VeneraNext-xxx-windows-installer.exe 安装包或 zip 便携版。便携版不受 winget 管理，需要手动下载新版本并覆盖更新。新版本发布后，winget 公共源可能需要等待 Microsoft 审核；可先执行 winget source update 刷新本地索引。

Windows 安装器、便携包和 winget manifest 维护说明见 doc/distribution/windows.zh.md。

3.4 HarmonyOS（测试版）

从 发布页 下载鸿蒙安装包。自 v1.18.3-rc.3 起，每次候选版和正式版发布均提供同版本的鸿蒙测试版：

文件名 说明 适用场景
VeneraNext-xxx-harmonyos-arm64-unsigned.hap 未签名 ARM64 测试版 满足 API 26 要求的鸿蒙手机与平板

需自行签名侧载；升级时沿用原签名密钥，不卸载或清空数据。安装步骤与功能限制见 鸿蒙测试版安装指南。

3.5 Linux

从 最新稳定版 下载对应架构的安装包：

发行版 / 方式 安装或运行
Debian / Ubuntu（DEB） sudo apt install ./venera-next_xxx_amd64.deb（ARM64 选择 arm64 包）
Fedora 等提供所需依赖的发行版（RPM） sudo dnf install ./venera-next-xxx.x86_64.rpm（ARM64 选择 aarch64 包）
Arch Linux（x86_64） sudo pacman -U ./venera-next-xxx-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
AppImage（x86_64 / ARM64） chmod +x VeneraNext-xxx-x86_64.AppImage，再执行 ./VeneraNext-xxx-x86_64.AppImage（ARM64 选择 aarch64 文件）

xxx 请替换为下载文件中的实际版本号。RPM 与 AppImage 提供 x86_64 和 ARM64 版本；可用 uname -m 查看机器架构。

Linux 安装包基于 Ubuntu 22.04 构建，glibc 基线为 2.35。当前稳定版 AppImage 已包含 GTK 3 和 WebKitGTK 4.1，无需额外安装 GTK/WebKit；仍需系统提供 glibc 2.35 或更新版本及兼容的 OpenGL/EGL 显卡驱动。依赖安装、FUSE 问题及发行版兼容范围见 Linux 安装与分发。

3.6 iOS

从 最新稳定版 下载 ipa 安装包，使用 AltStore 旁加载。

3.7 macOS

从 最新稳定版 下载 VeneraNext-xxx.dmg。

4. 快速上手

  1. 安装：从最新稳定版安装当前平台的版本；电视按 Android TV 说明选择独立 TV 包。
  2. 添加内容（三选一即可开始）：已有漫画文件 → “本地 → 导入”；网络连载 → 在漫画源管理页安装扩展；NAS 目录 → “设置 → 应用 → WebDAV 漫画库”。
  3. 开始阅读：手机与桌面默认的瀑布流模式可以直接跨章连读，TV 默认采用单页低内存阅读；遇到想追的连载，试试在详情页长按“收藏”按钮。阅读模式、拆分双页、夜间调光等可在“设置 → 阅读器”或阅读器内随时调整。

5. 使用说明

5.1 阅读模式与进度

模式 方向 适合
瀑布流（非 TV 默认） 从上到下 跨章节连续阅读，接近章末自动加载相邻章节
画廊 左→右 / 右→左 / 上→下 逐页翻看，可按阅读习惯设置多图布局
连续 左→右 / 右→左 / 上→下 当前章节内滚动，保留章节切换边界
  • 预加载：在“设置 → 阅读器”调整预加载图片数量，提前准备后面的图片，减少翻页等待；多加载一些也会占用更多流量和内存。
  • 继续阅读：进度记录章节与页码，瀑布流记录实际正在读的章节；详情页的正序/倒序只影响章节列表显示。
  • 独立阅读设置：可以为当前设备或某本漫画启用独立设置，不必每次重新调整。
  • 主线待发布：阅读工具栏可锁定菜单，锁定后靠边小锁解锁，翻页／滚动／缩放继续可用。纵向连续与瀑布流新增默认关闭的「裁剪左右白边」，关闭可恢复完整显示，原图与下载／导出不变，见左右边距与裁剪说明。
单页阅读模式 拆分双页模式

5.2 TV 遥控器与低内存阅读

  • 主界面：方向键移动焦点，确定键／手柄 A 激活；返回键／手柄 B 返回。支持菜单键的遥控器可打开部分控件的上下文菜单。
  • 阅读画面：方向键翻页或滚动，确定键打开阅读菜单；菜单打开后方向键只选择菜单控件，不会在背景翻页。返回先收起菜单，再保存进度并退出阅读器。
  • 默认低内存模式：单页阅读、预加载 1 页、64 MiB 解码图片缓存和约 207 万像素解码预算。可在“设置 → 阅读器 → TV 低内存模式”关闭，恢复原有阅读配置并使用瀑布流等模式；这个开关仅保存在当前设备，不参与备份或同步。
  • 使用提示：低内存模式不修改原文件，但长条图和放大细节可能变糊。网页登录、验证码和文件选择器等可能需要输入法或配套输入设备。

5.3 夜间与墨水屏阅读

  • 夜间调光：在阅读器内开启（阅读设置或底部快捷面板均可），亮度 20%–100% 可调，只作用于应用内画面；应用本身的浅色/深色/跟随系统主题在“设置 → 外观”选择。
  • 墨水屏：使用画廊模式并开启“电子墨水屏刷新”，可设置每 1–10 次翻页闪屏一次，时长为 100–1500 毫秒，样式有黑、白、先白后黑三种。连续与瀑布流模式不触发闪屏。

5.4 收藏、稍后阅读与追更

v1.18.4-rc.1 已提供「多选漫画」入口（宽屏工具栏／窄屏更多菜单）和「子目录排序」。主线待发布改进将全选／反选／取消选择放到有足够空间的顶栏，支持桌面 Esc 退出多选和搜索；详情收藏目录使用整个可用高度，新建文件夹固定在顶栏右侧。详见收藏目录与批量管理。

  • 收藏：点详情页“收藏”打开面板，可选择本地收藏夹，或收藏到源站账号（视扩展支持）。收藏页支持列表与封面画廊切换（自动或 2–6 列）。
  • 快捷收藏：在详情页长按“收藏”，直接加入指定的本地收藏夹，默认是“追更”。在“设置 → 本地收藏 → 快速收藏”更换目标。
  • 追更设置：在首页打开“追更”页，可更换要关注的收藏夹，也可点“立即检查”手动刷新。
  • 稍后阅读：在详情页或本地漫画菜单加入/移除，首页可进入完整列表；打开阅读不会自动移除。
  • 阅读统计：历史页查看累计阅读时长、读过的作品数和时长排行，可按保留天数清理历史。
  • 搜索快捷方式：常搜的作者/标签可保存为快捷方式，在搜索页一键复用。

5.5 本地漫画与离线下载

内容 导入与阅读方式
图片目录 支持单本、批量目录及章节子目录；封面可选，文件按自然顺序排列
CBZ / ZIP / 7Z / CB7 解压后导入本地库，支持带顶层目录和章节子目录的归档
PDF 支持多选逐本导入、进度与取消；逐页转为本地 JPEG，第一页作为封面
图片型 EPUB 按 EPUB 的阅读顺序导入漫画图片，尽量保留标题、作者、封面和章节目录
网络源下载 已下载章节进入本地漫画库，供离线阅读，也可用于后续导出和归档

支持导出 CBZ、扫描恢复下载内容、删除章节和迁移存储位置。PDF/EPUB 导入会占用额外空间；文字型 EPUB、直接绘制的 SVG 页面、加密 PDF 和 MOBI/AZW/AZW3 暂不支持。目录示例、压缩包兼容规则及元数据模板见本地漫画导入、CBZ 与 WebDAV 漫画库。

5.6 网络漫画源

网络内容由用户添加的 JavaScript 扩展提供，不同扩展支持的搜索、探索、分类、账号、收藏和评论入口可能不同。

在漫画源管理页添加兼容的脚本链接或文件。想编写自己的扩展，见下方漫画源开发。

5.7 WebDAV 数据同步、归档与在线漫画库

三类能力分别配置：

能力 “设置 → 应用”中的入口 用途
应用数据同步 数据同步 / Data Sync 同步设置、收藏、历史、Cookie 和源文件等，不包含本地漫画图片
漫画归档 漫画归档备份 / Comic Archive Backup 把本地漫画导出为 CBZ 上传，或下载归档恢复到本地库
在线漫画库 WebDAV 漫画库 / WebDAV Comic Library 按需读取远端图片目录，并缓存目录与图片

在线漫画库支持图片目录、章节子目录和 VeneraNext 导出 CBZ 的解压目录。metadata.json 可补充标题、作者、标签和章节信息。书架先显示已缓存的漫画，再检查服务端新增或改动的内容；可手动同步，也可设置自动更新周期。

远端 CBZ/ZIP/7Z/CB7 压缩包需要先在服务端解压，或通过归档恢复到本地后再阅读。详见目录与元数据规则。

5.8 关键词屏蔽

在「设置 → 探索」分别管理漫画和评论关键词。主线待发布版本增加「包含文字」「独立词」「标签完全匹配」及每条规则的大小写设置，可用示例试匹配，也可点击漫画列表的隐藏数量查看原因并编辑规则。短缩写如 BL 推荐使用「独立词」，避免误伤 black；旧规则保留原行为。

功能范围、匹配示例和备份兼容说明见关键词屏蔽与命中原因。当前稳定版 v1.18.3 尚未提供这些新入口。

6. 漫画源开发

第三方源开发者从这里开始：

文档 内容
漫画源编写指南 最小示例、搜索/详情/章节返回规则、图片请求与可选能力
最小源模板 可复制的 JS 文件，使用虚构接口演示完整加载流程
JavaScript API Network、HTML 解析、数据存储、UI、图片处理及运行时限制
本地调试 导入、编辑、JS Evaluator 与日志

英文对应文档：Comic Source Guide · JavaScript API · Local Source Debugging。

本分支继续维护兼容 Venera 的扩展接口。瀑布流、拆分双页和夜间调光由阅读器处理；扩展应提供稳定的漫画/章节标识、正确的章节与图片顺序、有效的更新日期，无需为每一种阅读模式另写一套规则。

7. FAQ

7.1 VeneraNext 自带漫画源吗？

不自带，也不提供推荐源列表。可以先导入本地漫画，或自行合法配置兼容扩展、WebDAV 漫画库。

7.2 搜索不到内容或图片加载失败怎么办？

先检查漫画源扩展、登录状态（Cookie）、源站状态和网络。具体站点和内容问题请联系相应扩展的维护者；可脱离具体站点复现的阅读器或扩展运行时问题，欢迎按贡献指南反馈。

7.3 追更多久检查一次？为什么没有更新提示？

  • 自动检查：应用运行时每 10 分钟检查一轮，最近 24 小时内已成功检查的作品会跳过；想马上刷新，可在追更页点“立即检查”。
  • 更新依据：扩展返回的有效更新时间发生变化后才会标记更新。只新增章节、更新时间没变化时，可能不会提示。
  • 更新标记：“设置 → 发现 → 在漫画缩略图上显示更新提示”控制缩略图上的标记，不影响追更检查和首页更新数量。

7.4 平板上怎样缩小条漫？

在阅读器设置中选择纵向连续或瀑布流模式，调整「条漫缩小（每侧边距）」。每侧设为 20% 时，图片宽度缩小到原来的 60%，高度按比例变化，并保留阅读进度。详见条漫缩小与左右边距。

7.5 Windows 怎样更新？

使用 winget upgrade --id CyrilPeng.VeneraNext --exact。公共源收录新版本可能晚于 GitHub Release，可先运行 winget source update。便携版需要下载新版本手动覆盖更新。

8. 开发者入口

  • 构建与开发：Flutter/Rust 环境、依赖锁定、测试和发布。
  • 鸿蒙随版构建：固定分支来源、独立 SDK、未签名 HAP 与发布门禁。
  • 贡献指南 · 依赖治理。
  • Windows 分发维护 · 无头命令模式。
  • 安全政策 · 行为准则 · 完整文档索引。

9. 星标历史

10. 声明

本仓库只维护 VeneraNext 漫画阅读器本体，不提供、内置、托管或推荐任何漫画源，也不处理任何源站内容。

网络阅读能力兼容 JavaScript 扩展 API，需要用户自行配置合法的漫画源扩展；搜索结果、章节加载、图片可用性和内容版权均取决于对应源站与扩展实现。

请不要在本仓库提交与漫画源、源站内容、具体作品可用性或版权相关的问题，此类反馈会直接关闭。

11. 赞助

赞助状态会通过爱发电 API 定期同步。需要公开鸣谢时，请在订单备注中填写“公开昵称：你的昵称”；未提供公开昵称的订单不会展示。

赞助者名单见 SPONSORS.md。

12. 致谢

感谢 Venera 提供的阅读器与扩展基础，以及 EhTagTranslation 的中文标签翻译数据。也感谢所有贡献者与赞助者。

Join the community to build AppFlowy together

Why Are We Building This?

Notion has been our favourite project and knowledge management tool in recent years because of its aesthetic appeal and functionality. Our team uses it daily, and we are on its paid plan. However, as we all know, Notion has its limitations. These include weak data security and poor compatibility with mobile devices. Likewise, alternative collaborative workplace management tools also have their constraints.

The limitations we encountered using these tools and our past work experience with collaborative productivity tools have led to our firm belief that there is a glass ceiling on what's possible for these tools in the future. This emanates from the fact that these tools will probably struggle to scale horizontally at some point and be forced to prioritize a proportion of customers whose needs differ from the rest. While decision-makers want a workplace OS, it is impossible to come up with a one-size fits all solution in such a fragmented market.

When a customer's evolving core needs are not satisfied, they either switch to another or build one from the ground up, in-house. Consequently, they either go under another ceiling or buy an expensive ticket to learn a hard lesson. This is a requirement for many resources and expertise, building a reliable and easy-to-use collaborative tool, not to mention the speed and native experience. The same may apply to individual users as well.

All these restrictions necessitate our mission - to make it possible for anyone to create apps that suit their needs well.

  • To individuals, we would like to offer Notion's functionality, data security, and cross-platform native experience.
  • To enterprises and hackers, AppFlowy is dedicated to offering building blocks and collaboration infra services to enable you to make apps on your own. Moreover, you have 100% control of your data. You can design and modify AppFlowy your way, with a single codebase written in Flutter and Rust supporting multiple platforms armed with long-term maintainability.

We decided to achieve this mission by upholding the three most fundamental values:

  • Data privacy first
  • Reliable native experience
  • Community-driven extensibility

We do not claim to outperform Notion in terms of functionality and design, at least for now. Besides, our priority doesn't lie in more functionality at the moment. Instead, we would like to cultivate a community to democratize the knowledge and wheels of making complex workplace management tools while enabling people and businesses to create beautiful things on their own by equipping them with a versatile toolbox of building blocks.

item.title: edde746/plezy
item.description:
Modern cross-platform media server client built with Flutter

https://plezy.app

Plezy

A modern client for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby on desktop, mobile, and TV. Built with Flutter for native performance and a clean interface.

Website · Screenshots · Download · Contributing · License

Download

Platform Download
macOS DMG (x64, arm64)
Linux x64 .deb · .rpm · .pkg.tar.zst · .flatpak · .AppImage · portable tar.gz
Linux arm64 .deb · .rpm · .pkg.tar.zst · .flatpak · .AppImage · portable tar.gz
Install with a package manager

macOS — Homebrew

brew install --cask plezy

Installed from the old edde746/plezy tap? After brew update moves Plezy to the official cask, run brew untap edde746/plezy.

Windows — WinGet

winget install edde746.Plezy

Linux — Flatpak

Install Flatpak with your distribution's package manager, download the bundle for your architecture above, then run:

flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//25.08
flatpak install --user ./plezy-linux-x64.flatpak
flatpak run com.edde746.plezy

On arm64, install plezy-linux-arm64.flatpak.

Sandbox, playback, and folder access
  • Not on Flathub — the remote supplies the Freedesktop runtime only.
  • Video playback needs a Wayland session; a pure X11 session shows the interface but cannot create the video plane.
  • No host or home filesystem access; app data lives in ~/.var/app/com.edde746.plezy/. Add host folders through the desktop file chooser portal, and keep download folders writable.
  • Network, display, audio, and device access are enabled. --device=all (Flatpak 1.14 compatibility) exposes more than GPUs and controllers; session-bus access stays filtered.

Linux — AppImage

Download the AppImage for your architecture above, then run:

chmod +x plezy-linux-x64.AppImage
./plezy-linux-x64.AppImage

Gear Lever and AppImageUpdate update it from the latest release. Without FUSE, add --appimage-extract-and-run.

Arch Linux — Pacman

Distribution package.

sudo pacman -S plezy

Fedora / Red Hat — DNF

Installation instructions · Community repository by @aldobarr.

Nix

Community package maintained by @mio-19 and @MiniHarinn.

aerynOS — Moss

Distribution package.

sudo moss pad plezy

Features

Browse & Discover

  • Libraries, collections, and playlists — video and audio
  • Shuffle a whole movie or TV library
  • Discover hub — Continue Watching, Next Up, trending, and recommendations
  • Continue Watching shows a title held in several libraries or on several servers once, and asks which copy to play
  • Cross-server search across every connected Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby server, including actors and directors
  • Filtering, sorting, and alphabetical jump navigation
  • Folder browsing and folder playback — home-video libraries open in folder view
  • Resolution, HDR/Dolby Vision, and audio-format badges on cards and detail pages
  • Favorites and unwatched library filters[1]
  • Extras — trailers, deleted scenes, behind-the-scenes

Explore & Requests

  • Explore tab — watchlist, trending, popular, and recommendation rows from Plex Discover[2], Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, Simkl, and Seerr[3]
  • Search any connected catalog source
  • Catalog titles matched back to your own libraries by external ID
  • Seerr — request movies and shows with per-season, 4K, and advanced destination options, and see request status inline
  • Watchlist sync — add and remove titles on Plex, Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, and Simkl from anywhere in the app

Playback

  • Wide codec support (HEVC, AV1, VP9, and more)
  • HDR and Dolby Vision[4]
  • Direct play, or transcode presets from 240p/320 kbps to 1080p/20 Mbps
  • Multi-version switching with per-version file details
  • Full ASS/SSA subtitles with customizable styling
  • Online subtitle search & download[2:1]
  • Audio & subtitle choices remembered per title, or follow the server's per-episode selections
  • Progress sync and resume
  • Auto-play next episode with skip intro / skip credits
  • Chapter navigation with thumbnail scrub previews
  • Playback speed from 0.25x to 8x, audio sync offset, sleep timer (fixed durations or end of video)
  • Video zoom 50-200% with pinch, presets, and hotkeys
  • Audio passthrough[5], output channel limit (5.1 or stereo, with center-channel boost), and loudness normalization
  • File Info sheet — every version, file, and stream the server reports
  • Ambient lighting and GLSL shader presets[6]
  • Picture-in-Picture[7]
  • Refresh-rate matching[8]
  • External player launch (VLC, MX Player, etc.) with progress sync back[9]

Music

  • Music libraries — artist, album, and track browsing with square artwork
  • Album and artist screens with play, shuffle, and Instant Mix
  • Gapless playback with a full play queue — reorder, remove, play next, add to queue
  • Now Playing with synced lyrics[10], persistent mini-player, and sleep timer
  • Background playback with lock-screen, media-key, and notification controls[11]
  • Offline playback of downloaded albums and tracks
  • Streaming quality presets — Original, 320, 192, or 128 kbps

Live TV & DVR

  • Live TV channel browsing, tuning, and favorites
  • EPG guide with What's On and per-show schedules
  • DVR recording rules, scheduled recordings, and a rememberable recording target library[2:2]
  • Multi-server Live TV support where available

Downloads & Offline

  • Download movies, shows, and music for offline playback[12]
  • Background queue with pause / resume
  • Sync rules for automatic downloads, with per-show "Include Specials"
  • Offline browsing with watch state sync-back on reconnect

Watch Together

  • Rooms on Open Watch Party — share a six-character code; friends join from Plezy or another Open Watch Party app
  • Everyone plays their own copy from their own server — Plex, Jellyfin, or Emby — matched by catalogue IDs, with a picker when several copies fit
  • Synchronized play / pause / seek, host or shared control, room lock, and host handoff
  • Public relays by default, or point Plezy at your own self-hosted relay

Integrations

  • Discord Rich Presence[13]
  • Trakt, MyAnimeList, AniList, and Simkl — ratings, watched sync, and real-time scrobbling[14]
  • Scores from connected trackers on detail pages — Trakt, Simkl, MyAnimeList, and AniList, plus Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd, IMDb, and TMDB through MDBList
  • Plezy Remote — control desktop and TV from mobile
  • Watch Next row and tvOS Top Shelf[15]
  • plezy:// links to open a profile, play a title, or tune a channel from Home Assistant, launchers, or an NFC tag; any movie, show, or episode menu shows its link[16]

Platform & Customization

  • Desktop, mobile, and TV — full D-pad, keyboard, and gamepad support
  • Multiple servers at once — Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby side by side
  • Profiles with per-profile downloads, watch state, and settings; Plex Home switching with PIN
  • Jellyfin and Emby local-server discovery and multiple URLs per server; Quick Connect sign-in[17]
  • TV layout options — corner spotlight backdrop, full-card artwork, and Force TV mode on desktop
  • Customizable keyboard shortcuts[13:1]
  • Metadata and artwork editing
  • Settings import/export
  • Localized in English plus 21 translations

plezy:// links

Links start Plezy from outside the app. Any link may add profile=<profile>: a profile id, a Plex Home user UUID, or a display name (ignoring case; it must match one profile). Plezy switches to that profile first, and a protected profile still asks for its PIN. A link replaces whatever is playing.

Link Does
plezy://open Opens Plezy
plezy://play?server=<server>&id=<item> Plays one item on one server, any backend
plezy://play?type=movie|show&tmdb=<n> Plays a title from whichever server has it. Use tmdb, tvdb, imdb=tt<n>, or plex=<hash> (the Plex GUID without plex://movie/)
plezy://live?channel=<channel> Tunes a Live TV channel by key, number, or call sign. Optional server=<server> and start=beginning|live

For a show, mode=next (the default) plays the next episode to watch, and mode=shuffle plays the show shuffled. The menu of any movie, show, or episode has Show link, and each profile's menu in Switch Profile has Show profile link. Both show the link as text and a QR code.

# Android / Android TV, over adb (Home Assistant: remote.turn_on with activity: plezy://...)
adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "plezy://play?type=show\&tvdb=81189\&profile=Kids"
# macOS
open "plezy://play?type=movie&tmdb=603"

On iOS, use the Open URLs action in Shortcuts.

Building from Source

Prerequisites

  • Flutter SDK 3.47.0+
  • A Plex account, or a Jellyfin or Emby server with user credentials

Setup

git clone https://github.com/edde746/plezy.git
cd plezy
flutter pub get
scripts/codegen.sh
flutter run
Code generation

After modifying model classes or other generated sources:

scripts/codegen.sh

After modifying translations:

dart run slang
Packaging a Flatpak bundle

Packages an already fully resolved Linux release bundle — pinned libmpv and bundled libraries included, not a Flathub source-build manifest. Run it on Linux, on the same architecture as the bundle, after following the bundle preparation steps in the Linux release workflow: flutter build linux alone does not produce all the required bundled libraries.

Install the packaging tools (Debian/Ubuntu shown) plus the native-architecture SDK and runtime:

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y flatpak flatpak-builder imagemagick
flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
flatpak install --user flathub org.freedesktop.Platform//25.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk//25.08

BUNDLE_DIR=build/linux/x64/release/bundle
python3 linux/packaging/build-flatpak.py --bundle "$BUNDLE_DIR" --arch x64 --output "$PWD"

That writes plezy-linux-x64.flatpak, installable with the Flatpak commands above; on arm64, use the prepared arm64 bundle directory and --arch arm64. Package from the checkout matching the bundle, since the version comes from pubspec.yaml.

Cross-architecture packaging needs native Flatpak tools, a registered binfmt interpreter, and the target SDK/runtime installed with flatpak install --user --arch=x86_64 (or aarch64) — never run Flatpak's namespace tools under emulation. Pass --arch x64 or --arch arm64 to the checker and the matching Flatpak architecture to flatpak run --arch=....

Check the installed package against the runtime (not just the SDK), then launch it on a Wayland desktop and exercise streaming, audio, downloads/offline playback, and file chooser portals:

python3 linux/packaging/check-flatpak.py

The check fails on a non-executable entry point or an unresolved bundled ELF dependency. A container without a GPU can use flatpak run --env=GALLIUM_DRIVER=softpipe com.edde746.plezy for software-rendered verification; this is not a hardware-decoding or HDR test.

Local checks 
scripts/ci_checks.sh

To install the same pre-commit checks locally:

scripts/setup_hooks.sh

End-to-end tests (Android emulator plus a Dockerized Jellyfin fixture):

python3 scripts/maestro/run_maestro.py basic

Contributing

See CONTRIBUTING.md for development workflow, formatting, tests, and translation guidelines.

License

Plezy is licensed under GPL-3.0. The license covers the code, not the Plezy name or logo; forks distributed beyond personal use must follow TRADEMARKS.md.

Acknowledgments

  • Supports Plex Media Server, Jellyfin, and Emby
  • Playback powered by mpv via our mpv-build pipeline (started as a fork of MPVKit; on Android through its mpv-android library, whose Kotlin/JNI glue descends from libmpv-android), Android ExoPlayer, and libass-android

  5. Desktop, Android TV, and Apple TV. ↩︎
